## Teaching Interests

- Coupled human–Earth systems
- Integrated assessment modeling for climate and energy policy
- Quantitative methods for environmental and social sciences
- Decision-making under uncertainty and scenario analysis

## Teaching Approach

My teaching interests focus on connecting quantitative methods with real-world environmental and policy questions. I am particularly interested in teaching how mathematical models, data analysis, and scenario-based reasoning can be used to study complex human–Earth systems and inform decision-making under uncertainty. I also value a balance of conceptual understanding, computational practice, and applied problem solving, with examples drawn from climate, energy, environmental health, and public policy.
